Kulwant Singh

Associate Manager – Digital Transformations/Process Excellence,

Business Consultant, Quality/Operations, (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certified), Certification with projects Digital, Transformation, AI & ML, SDD, BRD, RPA, UI path, Blue Prism, Process Automation As is V/S To be process, LLM,NLP , ISO 9001- 2015 Lead Auditor (QMS) ISO 31000 FMEA RISK MANAGEMENT Powe BI and Data Analytics,Certified professional AML, CTF, KYC,PEP, Transactions Monitoring, Screening Sanctions and Fraud Investigations and technology, Alert Remediation, Fintech,Operations, CAMS.Banking, Financial Risk and Risk Management, Chargeback Disputes, BFSI, Accounts Payable, Receivable.

Mob – 9599662599 Email:Gurdevsinghgurdev2019@gmail.com

SUMMARY

Every day, money is laundered — and banks have only minutes to respond. Providing solutions with the help of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Agentic and Generative AI/ML to reduce the TAT of processing banking alerts with more accuracy and save millions of dollars.

A detail-oriented Digital Transformation/Quality Manager professional with 10+ years of experience in Business & Operations Excellence, Business Transformation, Lean Six Sigma, Process Re- engineering, Quality Management System & Project Management. Skilled in conducting audits, implementing quality management systems, and facilitating training programs. Adept at identifying process gaps and recommending solutions to improve quality and productivity. Worked on various projects of Six Sigma and Digital transformations to improve the business and helped organisation earning profits in million dollars. Successfully completed various six sigma Projects.

Exceptional Operations Assistant Manager understands how to motivate, plan, track, and monitor achievement of operational goals. Possesses seasoned abilities with identification of operational issues and the methods to address them. Brings a Bachelor’s degree in Economics and Management along with 6 years of operational management experience.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS TECHNICAL SKILLS

Service Delivery Data Analysis Operations Management Power Bi Dashboards Customer Management MYSQL Database People Management / Team Management VBA Automation Attrition control / Shrinkage Advance Excel Leadership Macros Problem Solving Minitab Adabptability Hypothesis Testing Risk / Compliance and Fraud Management UI Path, Blue Prism, Power Automate, Quality Management Automation Everywhere

Business Intelligence Random Forest, Decision Tree, Quantitative Analysis / Qualitative Analysis K-Means Clustering AML, KYC, PEP, Chargeback Disputes, Transaction Monitoring, Fraud Investigation, Lexis Nexis, World Check, Nexon, Sanctions Screening, Accounts Payable, Receivable

Critical Thinking Communications Decision Making Tools that I used : IEX, Verint, Avaya, Nice on Call, Amazon Connect etc.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS

High School

: Shiv Modern Secondary School C.B.S.E Board (1988 -1998.

Sr. Sec. School : C.B.S.E Board in the year (1998 – 2000). • BA (Business and Economics Hon’s) : University of Delhi (2000 – 2004).

Associate Manager - Process Excellence, Digital Transformation, Quality, RPA, PDD, BRD, SDD, BFSI, KYC, PEP. AML Rightsource Apr 2025 to Present (16 months)

Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with expertise in identifying and delivering large-scale transformation opportunities through Lean methodologies, process redesign, automation, and digital solutions. Experienced in leading metric improvement and productivity initiatives that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer and business outcomes.

Experienced professional with a demonstrated history of working Financial Crime and Risk Management industry. Quality Audits. Skilled in Anti Money Laundering, KYC, Alerts remediation, transaction monitoring, PEP Screening, Negative Media, Sanctions, Financial Risk, and Risk Management. Strong finance professional with a Business and Economics hon's focused in Business and Finance from Delhi University. Taking care of digital transformation of banking projects by using latest tools of RPA, AI and ML. SDD, BRD,PDD, Cost and Benefit estimation, Effort estimation, Pain Point Summary, ROI.

Saved millions of dollars by doing the important projects of Digital transformation and Six Sigma.

Lead enterprise-wide Process Excellence and Business Transformation initiatives. Pioneered initiatives like BDD, Automation Framework implementation.

Drive Lean Six Sigma programs (DMAIC, process mapping, gap analysis – AS-IS / TO-BE).

Identify and deliver cost savings, productivity gains, and quality improvements.

Conduct data-driven diagnostics to improve KPIs (AHT, FCR, SLA, NPS, error rates).

Process Discovery for RPA feasibility and publish Solution document for Implementation. Perform RCA and deploy sustainable solutions across operations.

- Identify automation opportunities using RPA and Intelligent Automation.

Evaluate and implement Gen AI use cases (copilots, QA automation, call summarization, virtual assistants).

Assess adoption of analytics for workflow orchestration and autonomous task enablement.

Leverage advanced analytics (descriptive, diagnostic, predictive) for opportunity identification.

Build business cases for AI/ML and automation initiatives and track impact realization.

Partner with Digital, Technology, CX, and Operations teams for execution and governance.

Track project milestones, measure benefits realization, and ensure adoption.

Assistant Manager – Digital Transformation, Payment Operations/Quality, Fintech, AML, KYC, Fraud investigations, Account Payable, Account Receivable Concentrix, Gurgaon 02/2017 - 06/2024

➢ In 2017 promoted as an Assistant Manager – digital transformations and lead a team of Green Belts to elevate Digital Transformation, Analytics, and Gen AI for BFSI vertical. Managing the operations seamlessly and timely SLA delivery along with maintaining high levels of employee and customer satisfaction. Managed various queues of Sanction screening, PEP Screening, Transactions Monitoring, CDD, EDD and KYC. Worked on tools like Lexis Nexis, Gold Tier, World Check, Nexon and eKYC. Demonstrated abilities at NPS, CSAT, CPH, Shrinkage, Attrition, efficiency and performance management, bottom Quartile management and customer experience management projects. Stakeholder management, client management, change management. Prepared meaning full MIS and Data insights reports by using Power BI, Advance excel. Assisted in data validation, contributing to data accuracy improvement by 10%.

➢ Guided business in restructuring their operations of Fintech, Credit / Debit cards Chargeback

disputes, Analysing and adjusting staffing to maximize efficiency and SL. Staffing Monitoring - If staffing is not proper, then following intraday changes to be done thru consensus with OPS team, Week off can be changed, Overtime, Real Time Post-mortem (Service level / Abandon). Which on average increased profits by 35% within one year.

➢ Efficiently communicated data-derived insights and plans to cross-functional team members and the management. Publish all reports related to Adherence, Attendance, Productivity & highlight Amoralities. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS/decks presentation as required. Daily reporting & Handling Incentive payout calculations for all sites. Provided actionable insights using data analytics, attended centralized and site management meeting as required, leading to a 50% increase in client retention rates for the firm.

➢ Have always been tremendous in seamless transitioning of new processes and closing the required projects with in time defined by Stakeholders and Clients. Transitioning of new processes and closing. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to revamp a client's e-commerce strategy, boosting business by 30%. Have been a part of capacity planning, strategic planning and tactic planning.

Achievements and Projects

Increased Business by 20%

Deployed AI-driven RPA bots for auto insurance, reducing claims processing times from 5 days to under 3 minutes.

Implemented real-time machine learning fraud detection engines, slashing fraudulent transactions and chargebacks by 40%.

Reduced Operational Costs

Overhauled the digital KYC and biometric verification journey, reducing user drop-off rates by 32% and slashing onboarding acquisition costs.

Improved Customer Satisfaction

I restructured the customer service process, which led to a 30% improvement in customer satisfaction scores within one year.

Team Lead Quality (Six Sigma Green Belt and Strategic Projects) Concentrix, Gurgaon 04/2012 – 02/2017

➢ Heading a team of 20 matured and intellectual Quality auditors. ➢ ISO 9001 Internal Audits, Managed end to end processes as well as monthly and annual audits,

successfully facilitate client audits.

➢ Lead various improvement projects along with process excellence team. ➢ Increase process efficiency resulting in revenue growth with implementation of effective and optimum prime team utilization; initiate process to generate new business ideas within the process to seek improvement ideas.

➢ Lead, motivated and trained team members to ensure high efficiency and quality as well as

maintained positive relationships with customers.

➢ Identify customer needs and oversee service delivery within the business context; determine

ways to reduce costs without sacrificing customer satisfaction.

➢ Manage conflict, and ensure the team's processes and tasks are carried out efficiently; remain

organized and meet deadlines.

➢ Assess customer feedback and using your creativity to establish, improve, and refine services. ➢ Build partnerships and liaison with team leaders to determine the company's services, delivery

criteria, and solutions for issues that may arise.

Joined IBM Daksh (Concentrix) in 2005 as a process associate of Customer Service. 12/2005 – 03/2012

Solved the queries of customers regarding billing and networking issues over mails and by processing transactions.

Forecasting and Data Analyst – Delhi University College internship 2004 - 2005

➢ During college internship as an Economics hons graduate worked with Hero Honda motors. Did research on the sales trends of Honda motors used Delphi, Regression, Time Series Moving Average analysis and find errors with cost and expenditure which was impacting total sales.

➢ Used Regression and Time series analysis in market and latest for gear and clutch tools which

resulted in increase the Honda motor sales by 20% and customer satisfaction by 50%.

CERTIFICATIONS AND ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS (IT AND DATA ANALYTICS)

Have done certification in Data Analysis from Aptech institute. Have sound knowledge of various latest IT applications like Advance excel, Power BI for data presentation, MySQL database, Macros.

Knowledge of IT languages : Python – Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, VBA work automation, Dax Query, MySQL.

PROJECTS

Created VBA project of combining data work on different sheets to a single sheet made it easier to track, sum and combine work automation. Reduced the time of combining and sum the data and increase the accuracy by 50%. Also data is completely safe for integrity and compliance purpose as we could track what work is being happened on all sheets.

Created a project of enter data on user form swiftly and accurately for the team and speed up the work by 30%

STRENGHTS

➢ Good listener and quick learner. ➢ Adaptive to new technology. ➢ Resilient to difficult work conditions / Stress Management, Change Management. ➢ Optimistic and always create positive moral.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth Language known

: 12-08-1983 : Hindi, English, Punjabi.
